title: Crash retrieval program head refused to talk

tellings.quote: Well, I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us. And that was that was Glen Gaffne.

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis says the man who led the crash retrieval program, a claimed secret effort to recover downed non-human craft, during the era in question was Glenn Gaffney, and that Gaffney refused to talk to them. Davis tells Michels this in connection with the documentary Age of Disclosure: "I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us." If true, the man best placed to confirm the program chose to stay silent.
